About the Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes Tuesday Ride group ride

A social road ride for riders 50 and older, split into an energetic A group and a relaxed B group. Rides cancel automatically in freezing, hot, wet or windy weather. The club also rides Thursdays (April–October) and Saturdays.
